branch_access.company_super_admin: The existing Super Admin role on the web guard grants company-wide branch access even when branch_id contains a default branch. CompanyScope remains unchanged: only is_system_owner bypasses tenant filtering.
branch_access.ordinary_staff: Existing branch restrictions and write checks remain active for other assigned staff. No NULL-branch records are backfilled or reassigned.
branch_access.selling_locations: Company Super Admin can select authorized selling locations across their company. Active, sellable, company/branch and allowed location type checks remain enforced.
branch_access.user_forms: The selected branch remains stored as the default branch. Forms explain that it does not narrow a company Super Admin’s company-wide access. No ordinary administrator is promoted to System Owner.
branch_access.settings: The company catalogue-price selector now also restricts company Super Admin to their own company; cross-company management is reserved for System Owner.

sale_date.storage: Existing sales.sale_date is reused. No business records or historical timestamps are rewritten.
sale_date.timezone: Default date and future-date checks use the company timezone, falling back to app.timezone.
sale_date.permission: sales.backdate; Super Admin/System Owner may backdate, authorized Admin roles receive the new grant, Cashier receives no automatic grant.
sale_date.limit: config/pos.php: max_backdate_days, environment override POS_MAX_BACKDATE_DAYS; default 30 days, zero disables backdating for everyone.
sale_date.confirmation: A past date requires explicit confirmation in the POS and in the transaction service.
sale_date.financial_controls: Closed cashbook sessions block both selected historical business dates and the actual recording date. Session rows are locked during the sale transaction.
sale_date.inventory: Sufficient current stock is checked under the existing inventory locks. Stock movements and payment dates use the actual recording date in company time. created_at/updated_at remain normal recording timestamps.
sale_date.reports: Sales reporting continues filtering by sale_date. Sales exports now add a Recorded at column. Receipts/invoices show the business date and separate entry time.
sale_date.whatsapp: Sale notifications use the business sale date. Historical notifications append separate recorded-at and notification-prepared timestamps in the configured company notification language.
sale_date.retry_safety: Existing sale idempotency keys and inventory transaction protections are retained.

limitations: Historical inventory balances are not reconstructed; inventory effects are posted at actual recording time.
The application has no general accounting-period locking system. This change enforces existing closed cashbook controls and the configurable backdate limit.

migration.type: Additive permission grant only; no sale schema or record backfill
migration.status: Applied to the verified local environment; no production records modified
migration.rollback: Preserves explicit administrator permission grants rather than deleting shared grants.

verification.status: Passed across suite runs and focused retests

localization_and_notification_regression.note: 48 passed in the suite; the remaining untranslated words in existing Swahili portal copy were translated and the catalogue test passed on rerun.

pos_branch_and_reporting_regressions.note: Two existing UI cases were updated to explicitly select English or Swahili instead of expecting mixed-language labels.

production: No production data changes, deployment or real customer notification sends.
